title: Rain World Boom over Artifact Fart
description: A resource pack made to replace the fart, as funny as it is, with the Rain World explosion sound effect
body:
Replaces the Artifacts's Mod's Whoopee Cushion sound effect with the Rain World Explosion sound effect. 

Artifacts is made by [Ochotonida](https://modrinth.com/user/ochotonida) and [Florens](https://modrinth.com/user/florens). Available on [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/artifacts) and Curseforge for [Forge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/artifacts) and [Fabric](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/artifacts-fabric)

[Rain World](https://store.steampowered.com/app/312520/Rain_World/) is made by Videocult.

Additional credits to Toby Fox for the second sound effect replacement, coming from [Deltarune](https://store.steampowered.com/app/1671210/DELTARUNE/)

I own none of the sounds or concepts in this resource pack. Please check out the source material for all of the following credited sources as they originate from indie creators.
